topic: Mastering Limits: From Intuition to Precision and Shortcuts

sections.title: The Intuitive Foundation: The 'Zeno's Rabbit' Approach
lecture_lines: A rabbit hops toward a carrot.
animations: Fade in a rabbit graphic labeled "Rabbit" at position x=0, color #FFFFFF.
Animate the rabbit jumping half the distance to x=1.
Animate the rabbit jumping half the remaining distance repeatedly.
Label the target point "Limit" at x=1, color #FF00FF.
Highlight the convergence point with a flashing circle.

sections.title: The Formal Rigor: Epsilon-Delta Definition (The Bodyguard Logic)
animations: Draw a function curve y=f(x) in color #00FFFF.
Display a rectangle around the limit point, labeled "Epsilon", color #FFFF00.
Display a corresponding interval on the x-axis labeled "Delta", color #00FF00.
Show the function values staying within the Epsilon-rectangle.
Shrink the Epsilon-rectangle to demonstrate limit convergence.

sections.title: The Computational Shortcut: L'Hôpital's Rule
animations: Display the ratio f(x)/g(x) in color #FFFFFF.
Show f'(x) and g'(x) appearing below with color #FF0000.
Animate an arrow showing the transformation to f'(x)/g'(x).

sections.title: Synthesis & Visual Summary
animations: Show a summary board with all three concepts listed.
Highlight the connection between Zeno, Epsilon, and L'Hôpital.
Fade all elements to black to conclude the video.
